entities.name: Location area identification
entities.description: An information element that may be included to assign a new location area identification to a UE during a combined attach procedure.

entities.name: Combined attach
entities.description: A procedure where a UE performs both EPS attach and non-EPS services attach simultaneously.

entities.name: May be included
entities.description: Condition indicating the location area identification IE is optional and may be included in the message during combined attach.

relations.description: The combined attach procedure may include the location area identification IE to assign a new location area to the UE.
The inclusion of the location area identification IE is guarded by the condition that it may be optionally included.
